source_issues.body:
Two accessible primary manuscripts leave protocol boundaries unresolved in the new borax and tincalconite records.

- Nishiyasu and Kyono (2024), [10.2138/am-2023-8970](https://doi.org/10.2138/am-2023-8970), institutional Revision 1 manuscript at [Tsukuba](https://tsukuba.repo.nii.ac.jp/records/2010200): Methods p. 7 ends DSC heating at 323 K, while Results p. 12/Figure 1 p. 32 report peaks at 349/408 K and plot to about 425 K. The publisher PDF was inaccessible; this finding applies to the inspected manuscript. Powder-XRD and single-crystal protocols are separate.
- Liu and Bish (2020), [10.1016/j.tca.2020.178759](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.tca.2020.178759), [OSTI manuscript](https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/1850965): Figure 6 caption p. 31 says borax disappears by downward 40%RH, while its continuation p. 32 lists borax as present through 40%RH. The qualified record keeps the broader 50–40% bracket, mixed qilianshanite-derived residue, persistent nahcolite,10-point RH steps and 2.5 h delays.

Acceptance: obtain the legitimate final version, original instrument/diffraction sequence or authoritative correction for each boundary. Preserve source versions and independent arms; do not infer a sharper equilibrium threshold, replicate count, phase fraction or recovered-boron yield. The paired round102-borates dossier records full inspection and access bounds.

This is a source-evidence follow-up, not an unresolved defect in the deliberately qualified record. Preserve the current limits until attributable primary evidence supports an update. source_issues.body:
Luck and Wang (2002), [10.2138/am-2002-2-319](https://doi.org/10.2138/am-2002-2-319), [complete original](https://www.rruff.net/doclib/am/vol87/AM87_350.pdf), gives Na6[B4O5(OH)4]3·8H2O in the abstract/discussion but H28B12Na6O27 and Mr 727.87776 in Table 1 p. 351. Expanding the written hydrated formula gives 35 oxygen atoms, not 27. The record excludes that table formula mass.

The current September 2026 IMA formula Na2B4O5(OH)4(H2O)3 also differs from the structural model's 2.667 waters per tetraborate unit. This is a nomenclature/model distinction, not evidence for a new species.

Acceptance: obtain the deposited CIF/refinement or authoritative clarification of Table 1 formula/mass; inspect any explicit CNMNC disposition of the water-site formula. Preserve modeled occupancies versus measured sample water and versioned authority. Do not manufacture an IMA number or rename the species. source_issues.body:
Wang et al. (2026), [10.1016/S1003-6326(26)67069-0](https://doi.org/10.1016/S1003-6326(26)67069-0), complete 13-page original, leaves several unresolved quantities. Sections 2.2/3.2 and Figures6/7 disagree on target temperatures: methods list 1473–1623 K, while the introduction/Figure 6 use 1523–1673 K. Figure 7a assigns 10.41% Zn inventory loss to 1323 K and 25.22% to 1473 K; Section 3.2 assigns 10.41% to 1473 K.

Equation 1 defines liquid assay Ci aswt.% with unclear phase-normalization units. Replicate counts and the meaning of error bars are not explicit. Section 3.3 proposes desulfurization followed by 1373 K smelting and an iron concentrate without a distinct complete protocol/product characterization in the inspected original. References on other feeds cannot supply those data.

Acceptance: acquire an attributable correction or original run/assay data establishing temperature labels, units, replicate/error definitions and the claimed lower-temperature sequence. A collected-product mass balance, vapor/dust composition and purity are required before treating Eq. 2 slag Zn inventory loss as isolated recovery. Keep the supported 17.5 wt.% anthracite / 1623 K / 90 min observation qualified, and the author-described toxicity extraction test separate from independently verified compliance.

Owner: data/records/zinc-leach-residue.yaml; evidence dossier: research/sources/round102-zinc. The separate inaccessible microbial 2017 study remains under #186; this issue neither duplicates nor resolves that access gap.

Methods/results describe 35 days,30 days,week 4 and eight-week flask endpoints in different places. Section 2.3 assigns the composite resin feed to stirred tanks while Section 3.3 refers to flask leachates.

source_issues.body:
Bayarsaikhan et al. (2025), [10.1039/D4RA07845D](https://doi.org/10.1039/D4RA07845D), full PMC11811698 XML/tables and original Figures1–8, supports a treatment-associated increase in subsequent acid leaching, not isolated microbial causation or product recovery. The owner is data/records/carbonatite-associated-rare-earth-ore.yaml; association with a carbonatite deposit does not establish the modal rock classification of every tested sample.

The experiment lacks a matched sterile 9 K/NBRIP pretreatment or killed-cell control. Initial pH values in Figure 5 and prose differ. Equation 1 declares initial ore mass in g and ore concentration in mg/kg without an explicit g-to-kg conversion; original calculation units need clarification. A balance across pretreatment liquid, rinses, dried residues and final acid leachate is not reported; percentage denominators do not resolve interstage losses. Figure 3 retains weak culture-only release, which the abstract's broad wording obscures. No measured organic-acid profile or mineral-specific metabolic assay establishes the proposed molecular route.

ENA OR053813.1/OR053804.1 resolve Tmix members' partial 16S sequences to Thiobacillus denitrificans 2mn and Bacillus cereus 1mn. The separate culture's printed 4TH0UUSC016 identifier remains unresolved and its Gram-negative description adds uncertainty; do not merge that culture with a resolved Tmix member. Related DOI 10.63278/1371 shares investigators/accessions/sites and is not independent replication.

Acceptance: obtain attributable control/recipe/pH and sample-level interstage inventories; resolve the separate culture's original accession and taxonomy. publication_review_issues.body:
The generated site calls the `separation` category “Bioseparation” and describes microbial biomolecules as its universal basis. The new uranium-tailings resin-sorption and zinc-residue acid-separation mechanisms explicitly have `microbial: false`. Their source records are correctly qualified; the display wording overstates biological involvement.

Maintained owner: `scripts/render_pages.py`, `PROCESS_LABELS` and `PROCESS_BLURBS`. Independent initial review: `reviews/publication/20261015-round102/20261015T203020Z-separation-display-initial.{json,md}`. Stable key: `CMMMech:publication:separation-microbial-scope`. Minor presentation finding; distinct from the earlier redox wording issue #373.

Acceptance:

- Use neutral “Separation” and a description covering biological or abiotic partitioning, with microbial involvement and recovery limits specified by each record.
- Preserve process-counting logic and all scientific owner/history/review bytes.
- Regenerate affected pages and run the existing rendering tests, lint and freshness checks.
- Save a successor review linked to the exact initial finding, independently confirming the maintained and generated corrections.

publication_review_issues.body:
Independent review found a receipt-writing defect in two temporary round102 publication helpers: `cmm-round102-final-gates.py` and `cmm-round102-preservation-before-commit-check.py`. They check path absence and later call `write_text()`. A dangling symlink can pass the existence check, and a competing creator can occupy the path before the later write. No actual overwritten file has been observed; the reproduction used isolated temporary paths.

Initial review: `reviews/publication/20261015-round102/20261015T203120Z-publication-helpers-initial.{json,md}`. Stable key: `CMMMech:publication:round102-gate-receipt-exclusivity`. Reproduction and exact reviewed source snapshots: `/private/tmp/cmm-round102-helper-audit`. This is the previously corrected #367 pattern on two different helpers; the already corrected coverage helper is unaffected.

Acceptance:

- Preserve the executing helper and its eventual receipt until the run finishes; retain original source snapshots and initial audit.
- Refuse existing files and symlinks, including dangling links, and create final receipts with exclusive file creation.
- Test fresh creation, occupied regular files, live and dangling symlinks, and a competing creator without touching live publication receipts.
- Save an independent successor bound to the corrected helper hashes and regression results, explicitly retaining successful earlier checks as historical executions of the earlier helper.
- Preserve all scientific owners, histories and saved reviews.
publication_review_issues.title: Make round102 gate and preservation receipt creation exclusive

publication_review_issues.body:
Read-only pre-execution review of the reused publication helpers identified safeguards needed before the round102 merge and cleanup. The current worktree and original main have not been harmed; the risky operations have not run for this batch.

- A plain `git merge --ff-only` defaults to overwriting ignored files. The later preservation check would detect damage only after it occurred. Add `--no-overwrite-ignore` and reject collisions between newly tracked paths and the preserved nontracked inventory before advancing main.
- Local cleanup checks the topic SHA and then separately force-deletes the branch. Use expected-old-OID compare-and-delete after detaching and confirming no listed worktree owns the branch. Preserve any harmless branch configuration rather than risk removing concurrently created configuration. Keep the remote deletion's existing explicit lease.
- Queue admission must bind the PR base ref to `main`, the expected head ref and both repository identities, as well as the existing commit/tree checks.
- Hosted evidence should re-list matching workflow runs before concluding that the selected run/attempt remains latest. Verify queue ancestry and retain the limitation that final remote observations are not atomic locks.

Acceptance: preserve the initial audit and exact original helper hashes; test ignored-file collision refusal and expected-OID branch deletion against isolated toy repositories; independently review corrected helper bytes and the final concrete PR/head/tree/base/receipt bindings. Do not execute merge or branch cleanup until these findings are resolved. Existing saved scientific reviews, owners and histories remain unchanged.

Git semantics: [merge overwrite-ignore](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-merge), [expected-old-OID update-ref](https://git-scm.com/docs/git-update-ref.html). Evidence is retained under `reviews/publication/20261015-round102/` and the local operational guard audit directory.
publication_review_issues.title: Guard publication fast-forward, branch deletion and hosted evidence bindings
